name: SLO and budget keys of the registry
description: Quality requirements held as registry values: the 7 SLO and budget keys that are active thresholds; budgets.pr_commits_max (0, unlimited under D-307) and budgets.pr_commits_min (1, structural commit-plan floor enforced by STD-commit-check-plan-errors) remain configuration items (CFG), not quality requirements (D-356, proposed).
